source: HostTick v1 one-transition projection of Buildings CDL.Logical.Pre.mo (initial equation pre(u)=pre_u_start; y=pre(u)) per docs/execution-profile.md; independent of oce-blocks, not a Modelica event-iteration oracle
input: pre_u_start=true; u=[F,F,T,F,T] at 60 s ticks; u is false on the first tick
reference_rule: HostTick v1 projection of Buildings CDL/Logical/Pre.mo: y[0] = pre_u_start (initial equation pre(u)=pre_u_start, line 14); y[k] = u[k-1] for k >= 1 (y=pre(u), line 17, one transition per tick)
diverges_from_modelica_event_iteration: Pre.mo line 17 y=pre(u) is a one-event-iteration delay; Modelica iterates at each input event until u == pre(u), so a converged trace reports y == u after every event. HostTick v1 performs no same-time event iteration: y at tick k is u at tick k-1 and y at the first tick is pre_u_start. This reference pins the HostTick v1 projection and claims no Modelica event-iteration equivalence.
format: Modelica CombiTimeTable CSV (_spec/07 §9); signal CSV is time+one output; reference.csv is time+inputs+all outputs; ryu shortest-round-trip f64
